have hbnd : Integrable bnd := by

  apply Filter.Eventually.of_forall

    have hz0 := (hg t htJ).1.2.2.1 x hxc

    exact (h_T004.1 x t ht).1

  filter_upwards [hevent] with h hh
  simp [v, hh, smul_eq_mul, div_eq_mul_inv, mul_comm]

apply hasDerivAt_iff_tendsto_slope_zero.mpr
apply hDCT.congr'
filter_upwards [hevent] with h hh
have hp : 0 < t+h := by linarith [(hsmall h hh.2).1]
simp only [v, if_pos hh, integral_div, integral_sub (h_T003.2 (t+h) hp) (h_T003.2 t ht),
  energy, smul_eq_mul, div_eq_mul_inv, mul_comm]
